[LSER.8.1.1] A `where` that reads a series aggregation is time-dependent
([LTIM.2.4.1]), and [LTIM.2.4]–[LTIM.2.7] govern it as they govern a clock
read. It is re-evaluated when the pattern's bindings change and on every tick,
against the series as they stood when the pump began ([LTIM.2.4.3]). Its rule
fires once per false → true edge for a matched fact wrapper ([LTIM.2.5.1]). A
`logical` fact it justifies is retracted at the pump whose snapshot refuses the
match ([LLOG.3.11.1]). On a rule with more than one positive pattern it is
refused ([LTIM.2.6.2]).
